description: Compare two strings (usernames, domains, brand or command names) with Unicode UTS #39 skeletons and say whether they can look the same to a reader: identical, confusable, confusable_ignoring_case or distinct. Also returns each string's scripts, whether it mixes scripts, and its skeleton. Up to 1024 code points each. Pure text analysis, nothing stored. Read-only. Same engine as POST /api/compare.

a.description: First string, e.g. the trusted name "paypal".

b.description: Second string, e.g. the name you received.

name: compare_strings
title: Check whether two strings are visually confusable
